rule.assert: CSIP7;ERROR;The metsHdr element MUST have a CREATEDATE attribute.
CSIP8;WARN;The metsHdr element SHOULD have a LASTMODDATE attribute.
CSIP9;ERROR;The metsHdr element MUST have a csip:OAISPACKAGETYPE attribute.
CSIP10;ERROR;The metsHdr element MUST contain an agent element that records the software used to create the package.
CSIP11;ERROR;The agent element MUST have a ROLE attribute with the value "CREATOR".
CSIP12;ERROR;The agent element MUST have a TYPE attribute with the value "OTHER".
CSIP13;ERROR;The agent element MUST have a OTHERTYPE attribute with the value "SOFTWARE".
CSIP14;ERROR;The agent element MUST have a child name element that records the name of the software tool used to create the IP.
CSIP15;ERROR;The agent element MUST have a child note element that records the version of the tool used to create the IP.
CSIP16;ERROR;The mandatory agent element’s note child has a @csip:NOTETYPE attribute with a fixed value of “SOFTWARE VERSION”.
